statement: Hand argument proposes last fall degree at most 2*sum(q_i-1)+2 for two fully split rational membership towers with coprime N_i,D_i, deg N_i=q_i, deg D_i<=q_i-1, plus the written quadratic Vieta core over F_p, p>3. Binary towers give2*log2(M)+2. Includes a homogeneous interpolation-free target-evaluator construction and an exact F17 polynomial/prime-curve example. General proof awaits independent/formal validation; no general rational-tower Rust solver, cheap-construction or running-time claim.
